# wallix.bastion.device_localdomain_account_credential

Manage credentials of a device local domain account on a WALLIX Bastion — module

*Added in version 1.0.0 of `wallix.bastion`.*

## Synopsis

- Create, update or delete the password or the SSH key of an account of a device local domain on a WALLIX Bastion.
- Equivalent of the `wallix-bastion_device_localdomain_account_credential` Terraform resource.
- An account has at most one credential of each [`type`](#parameter-type), so [`type`](#parameter-type) identifies the credential.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Comments |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="parameter-account-name"></a>**account_name** | `str` / required | Name of the account of the local domain the credential belongs to. The account must exist. |
| <a id="parameter-api-version"></a>**api_version** | `str` | Version of the Bastion REST API to use, `v3.8` or `v3.12`.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_API_VERSION` environment variable is used, then `v3.12`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-host"></a>**bastion_host** | `str` | Hostname or IP address of the WALLIX Bastion.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_HOST` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-password"></a>**bastion_password** | `str` | Password of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PASSWORD` environment variable is used.<br>One of [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password) or [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token) is required. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-port"></a>**bastion_port** | `int` | HTTPS port of the WALLIX Bastion API.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_PORT` environment variable is used, then `443`. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-timeout"></a>**bastion_timeout** | `int` | Timeout in seconds of each HTTP request to the Bastion API.<br><br>Default: `30` |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-token"></a>**bastion_token** | `str` | API key of [`bastion_user`](#parameter-bastion-user). Takes precedence over [`bastion_password`](#parameter-bastion-password).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_TOKEN` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-bastion-user"></a>**bastion_user** | `str` | User to authenticate with. With [`bastion_token`](#parameter-bastion-token), the user the API key belongs to.<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_BASTION_USER` environment variable is used. |
| <a id="parameter-csrf-enabled"></a>**csrf_enabled** | `bool` | Send the CSRF token the Bastion issues at login (Bastion 12.0.3 and later).<br>If not set, the value of the `WALLIX_CSRF_ENABLED` environment variable is used, then `true`. |
| <a id="parameter-device-name"></a>**device_name** | `str` / required | Name of the device. The device must exist. |
| <a id="parameter-domain-name"></a>**domain_name** | `str` / required | Name of the local domain of the device. The local domain must exist. |
| <a id="parameter-passphrase"></a>**passphrase** | `str` | Passphrase of [`private_key`](#parameter-private-key).<br>The Bastion never returns it, so it cannot be compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-password"></a>**password** | `str` | The password, for [`type=password`](#parameter-type).<br>Required when the credential does not exist yet and [`type=password`](#parameter-type).<br>The Bastion never returns it, so it cannot be compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-private-key"></a>**private_key** | `str` | The SSH private key, for [`type=ssh_key`](#parameter-type), or `generate:<type>` to have the Bastion generate one, for example `generate:ED25519` or `generate:RSA_4096`.<br>Required when the credential does not exist yet and [`type=ssh_key`](#parameter-type).<br>The Bastion never returns it, so it cannot be compared. See [`update_password`](#parameter-update-password). |
| <a id="parameter-state"></a>**state** | `str` | Whether the credential should exist.<br><br>Choices: `present` (default), `absent` |
| <a id="parameter-type"></a>**type** | `str` / required | Type of the credential. Identifies the credential of the account.<br><br>Choices: `password`, `ssh_key` |
| <a id="parameter-update-password"></a>**update_password** | `str` | `on_create` sends [`password`](#parameter-password), [`private_key`](#parameter-private-key) and [`passphrase`](#parameter-passphrase) only when the credential is created.<br>`always` sends them on every run, which then always reports a change. The credential is replaced in place. With [`private_key=generate:<type>`](#parameter-private-key), this generates a new key on every run.<br><br>Choices: `always`, `on_create` (default) |
| <a id="parameter-validate-certs"></a>**validate_certs** | `bool` | Whether to validate the Bastion's TLS certificate.<br>Only disable this for test instances with self-signed certificates.<br>If not set, `WALLIX_BASTION_VALIDATE_CERTS` is used, then the inverse of `WALLIX_INSECURE_SKIP_VERIFY`, then `true`. |

## Attributes

| Attribute | Support | Description |
|---|---|---|
| **check_mode** | full | Can run in check_mode and return changed status prediction without modifying target. |
| **diff_mode** | full | Will return details on what has changed (or possibly needs changing in check_mode), when in diff mode. |

## Notes

- With [`state=absent`](#parameter-state), a missing device, local domain or account is not an error.
- The environment variables are the ones of the `wallix/wallix-bastion` Terraform provider, so one shell configuration serves both tools.
- Set the connection options once per play with `module_defaults` and the `group/wallix.bastion.bastion` action group.
- These modules call the Bastion API from the host they run on; use them with `delegate_to` or on a play targeting `localhost`.

## Examples

```yaml
- name: Set the password of the root account
  wallix.bastion.device_localdomain_account_credential:
    device_name: srv-linux-01
    domain_name: local
    account_name: root
    type: password
    password: "{{ vault_root_password }}"

- name: Have the Bastion generate an SSH key for the account
  wallix.bastion.device_localdomain_account_credential:
    device_name: srv-linux-01
    domain_name: local
    account_name: root
    type: ssh_key
    private_key: generate:ED25519
  register: key

- name: Show the public key to install on the server
  ansible.builtin.debug:
    msg: "{{ key.credential.public_key }}"

- name: Rotate the password on every run
  wallix.bastion.device_localdomain_account_credential:
    device_name: srv-linux-01
    domain_name: local
    account_name: root
    type: password
    password: "{{ vault_root_new_password }}"
    update_password: always

- name: Remove the SSH key
  wallix.bastion.device_localdomain_account_credential:
    device_name: srv-linux-01
    domain_name: local
    account_name: root
    type: ssh_key
    state: absent
```

## Return values

| Key | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| <a id="return-changed-fields"></a>**changed_fields** | `list / elements=str` | Options that were updated. Contains the secret options that were set when [`update_password=always`](#parameter-update-password).<br><br>Returned: when the credential already existed and [`state=present`](#parameter-state)<br><br>Sample: `["password"]` |
| <a id="return-credential"></a>**credential** | `dict` | The credential as returned by the Bastion API after the change, without its secrets.<br>In check mode, the expected credential. `null` when [`state=absent`](#parameter-state).<br><br>Returned: always<br><br>Sample: see [below](#sample-credential) |

<a id="sample-credential"></a>

### Sample of `credential`

```yaml
id: 1a0f6dbd1f68d4e8005056b66c8b
key_id: f9a17c67bd374e81bd9d4222e305f3b9
public_key: ssh-ed25519 AAAAC3NzaC1lZDI1NTE5AAAAIC8AUFSJcx+fgI7j0JboX1MhgxEot4gYI1sJubI9HsG3
type: ssh_key
url: https://bastion.example.com/api/v3.12/devices/1a0f.../credentials/1a0f6dbd1f68d4e8005056b66c8b
```
